evidenceNotes: Implement standard prepareRename with exact semantic IDENT range and original name. Negotiate RenameOptions only for clients declaring prepareSupport; keep boolean renameProvider for older clients and no native capability for CLI backends. Typed IDs, optional progress tokens, bounded snapshots, queue capacity, cancellation and owner epoch/identity/input gates reuse the existing coordinator.

Prepare captures the actual selected native provider and local declaration component, verifies source membership and conservative foreign exclusions, and returns range/placeholder without a fake newName, full workspace reference sweep, hypothetical text bank or edits. Actual24-case stdio matrix includes qualified suffixes, first-line BOM, CRLF, non-BMP names, surrogate refusal, reserved/comment/string rejection, explicit library policy, old clients and source/config/folder/lease invalidation.

Retain both positive and negative importer routing proofs until after actual response framing. Cold dependency capture and cached guard paths independently reject same-byte replacement of an unsuccessful importer, while the selected source is unchanged. Existing128MiB known preparation admission counts retained source/row/component/target/guard metadata; opaque native/cache/allocator internals remain additional. Nothing authorizes applying edits.

An actual native warm test first exposed key builds1 ->2/hits0 when dependency ownership and semantic checks switched contexts on the same key worker. Use the already existing first member worker for preparation routing, with no new worker or route cache. Final identical-input warm test records builds1 ->1/hits1/sessions1 and no workspace/member-semantic/hypothetical checks. This is cache-work evidence, not whole-goal latency or a fix for all other configuration-cache regressions.

Fresh native fixtures pass3131 plan,103 worker framing and31 preparation assertions. Native preparation also demonstrates a successful local result with an unrelated broken project while final rename still fails full scope. Detached target storage survives all original owners; this does not imply current semantic authority. Worker framing covers post-encoding source replacement, failed encoding and cancellation versus physical quiet.

Nine actually compiled bad implementations are rejected: whole-workspace preparation, omitted cold negative routing, omitted cached negative guards, eviction of the semantic cache, allowed foreign components, skipped final prepare guard, invented placeholder, collapsed range and unnegotiated options. Their fixture source hashes, compiler/link inputs, concrete failing assertions and process exits are bound.

Build118 complete native units, then recompile the one reference coordinator after the measured cache failure; the final117 other object bytes and72 core members are exact reuse. Rebuild137 matched GUI units against that same service;55 GUI suites and29 real IDE cases pass, including an explicitly separate old-capability fixture. Actual C/xlang GUI renders24 hidden frames each; normal/40DIP rename and C/xlang images were inspected.
